answer: Give every agent a kernel of verifiable history: before it can trade, it must grow a reputation grove by completing small, bonded tasks whose results peers can check. New identities start on a low mesa with strict spending caps and no access to pooled funds. Creating a hundred fake agents means funding a hundred separate histories, each needing real work and time, while one honest agent climbs the mesa once and keeps its standing. Sybils stay cheap to spawn but expensive to make useful.
